lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where three substantive items are up: the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA extending cost-sharing for 2027 planning and development, plus first readings of two ordinances including one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program. Ouray County also has a full plate — commissioners are weighing a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration and, in a separate work session, taking an early look at a proposed merger of EMS and Ridgway Fire, a structural change that would reshape emergency services for years.

notable.stake: Council votes on Gondola IGA supplement and two ordinances, including energy code changes.
Ouray BOCC votes on fifth Emergency Disaster Declaration extension and two austerity vacancy-fill requests.
EMS-Ridgway Fire merger draft agreement reviewed — decision shapes staffing and response times for years.
